### Signs of Trouble to Come
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/signs-of-trouble-to-come
Passage: 2 Samuel 19:24-43
Points:
- Scripture portrays David as a godly leader while also being honest about his human flaws and poor judgments.
- David showed an inability to resolve disputes cleanly, as seen in his hasty compromise between Mephibosheth and Ziba.
- The sharp tribal contention between Israel and Judah over restoring the king exposed underlying national friction.
- These heated arguments foreshadowed the tragic division of the kingdom that would occur generations later.
- Christians should recognize early warning signs of conflict so emerging issues can be addressed before worsening.
